{"id":2047485901,"question_id":3299,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1782540395,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"71 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2047485901/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Maximum Number of Elements in Subset","memory":"122.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    int maximumLength(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<ll,int>mp;\n\n        for(auto it : nums) mp[it]++;\n\n        int maxlen = 1;\n\n        if(mp.count(1))\n        {\n            int freq = mp[1];\n            maxlen = max(maxlen , (freq % 2 == 0) ? freq - 1 : freq);\n        }\n\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            ll number = it.first;\n            int freq = it.second;\n            int len = 0;\n\n            if(number == 1)  continue;\n            while(mp.count(number) and mp[number] >= 2)\n            {\n                len += 2;\n                if(number > 1000000000LL) break;\n                ll nextnumber = number * number;\n                number = nextnumber;\n            }\n\n            if(mp.count(number)) len++;\n            else len--;\n\n            maxlen = max(maxlen , len);\n        }\n        return maxlen;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-maximum-number-of-elements-in-subset","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2241}
